extracted.intended_audience: researchers and research organisations seeking EPSRC/UKRI funding (UK-based applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and procedural requirements for identifying and applying to EPSRC funding opportunities (eligibility, timelines, funding types and amounts, co-funders). Targets UK research organisations and invited applicants where specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant eligibility — UK research organisation
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for EPSRC funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit eligibility requirement for at least some opportunities (e.g., Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills). The page does not list the full eligibility criteria or how to check organisational eligibility; applicants should verify their organisation meets EPSRC eligibility rules before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some opportunities (e.g., 'UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment') are invite-only; unsolicited applications will not be accepted. Check opportunity details to confirm whether invitation is required and who issues invitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each opportunity specifies the type of funding being offered (grant). Applicants should confirm that the project they propose fits the funding type and associated conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award range / total fund
rubrics_metrics.description: Award range: e.g., £10,000,000 - £11,300,000 (Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills); Total fund: £3,000,000 (UKRI metascience scientometrics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opportunities list indicative award ranges or total funds available. Use these figures to assess project scale and likelihood of funding; check further guidance for whether amounts are per award or total programme funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding level / contribution rate (FEC)
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opportunities may state the expected contribution rate toward full economic costs (FEC). Applicants must plan budgets consistent with the stated FEC percentage and follow EPSRC/UKRI costing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity status
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each listing shows whether the opportunity is open, closed, forthcoming, etc. Only open opportunities accept applications; track status changes on the EPSRC site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key dates and times
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication date, opening date and time, closing date and time (e.g., Opening date: 6 May 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date: 7 July 2026 4:00pm UK time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must submit within the stated window and observe the exact times (UK time). Note publication dates may indicate when full guidance was published; check deadlines carefully.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of funders and co-funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Funders and co-funders are listed for each opportunity (e.g., EPSRC; UKRI, ESRC, NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, MRC; co-funders: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The involvement of multiple councils or government departments may affect the scope, assessment criteria, or eligibility rules. Review opportunity pages for any co-funder-specific conditions.
